title: Tola
description: Ruler of Israel. Person record added by the CFAH pass from the per-king rows of the OSF preprint CFAH-14 (Table 5, "CFAH Reconstructed Eponym List (CFAH-REL)"); its dates are display only.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year.

reign.date: Column: Ruler of Israel; Name row (Year BC): 1215; Last regnal-year row (Year BC): 1193 (year 23)
reign.citation: Griffith & White, "CFAH-14: Ancient Assyria," OSF preprint v1.0 (27 Feb 2026), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/9FUW2, file CFAH-14_Assyria_v_1.0.pdf, Table 5 "CFAH Reconstructed Eponym List (CFAH-REL)", pp. 47–49
reign.note: Row "Tola" of Table 5 (Israel). Year-by-year table (1262-963 BC). A ruler's name is printed in one year row and his regnal-year numbers in the following rows; each row here gives the Year BC of the name row and of the last numbered row, as printed. No year is computed from a length.

reign.citation: Raleigh, The History of the World (1617, EEBO-TCP A10357), Chronological Table, sig. 785b
reign.note: Year cell "3457 2775 262". The third printed figure 262 is the column "Exodus", not a length. To the Reader (sig. 780b): the Julian Period exceeds the yeere of the World by 682. The 23 at the end of the name is the reign length he prints. The end year is not printed on this row. Column: Israel..
